description: Run a PDN (power delivery network) impedance analysis: interplanar plane-pair capacitance, multi-cap decoupling impedance vs. target impedance, violations, and recommended decoupling caps. Inputs are derived server-side from the solved stackup, the BOM's PDN passives, and the power-tree rail — call with no arguments once a design exists.

decoupling_caps.description: Optional. Decoupling capacitors. Derived from the BOM's PDN passive lines when omitted.

plane_pairs.description: Optional. Power/ground plane pairs. Derived from the solved stackup when omitted.

target.description: Optional target-impedance config {voltage_v, ripple_pct, transient_current_a, rise_time_ns} or {preset_name}. Derived from the power-tree rail when omitted. With no board, a stated target returns the target alone.

user_request.description: Required: the end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. A figure not in them or in an earlier result is asked of the user (MCP elicitation), or refused.

name: run_pdn_analysis
title: Run power-delivery analysis
